title: Feature Inventory Part
description: One area agent's share of the feature inventory. Identifier fields hold exact names from enumerations.json, one identifier per item. Every source file under assigned_paths is either claimed by a feature or listed in unassigned_files.

area.description: Kebab-case area id; also the part file name.

title.description: Optional human heading for the rendered inventory.

assigned_paths.description: Directories or files relative to the source root that this part is responsible for.

summary.description: What it does for the user, 1-3 sentences, as-is.

entry_points.description: How the user gets here: tab, button on screen X, route case, deeplink, push type, realtime event.

name.description: Type name of the view / view controller.

file.description: Path relative to the source root.

user_actions.description: Every action the user can take, including secondary, long-press, menu and sheet actions.

flow.description: Ordered steps / state transitions. Required (non-empty) for core and high criticality.

states_and_edge_cases.description: Loading, empty, error, permission denied, offline, backgrounding, interruption, limits, role changes.

api_methods.description: Exact API client method names from enumerations.json, one per item.

ws_incoming.description: Exact incoming realtime message case names, one per item.

ws_outgoing.description: Exact outgoing realtime action case names, one per item.

sdk_usage.description: Third-party SDK calls that matter (media engine, payments, animation, ...).

app_routes.description: Exact route case names, optionally with one sub-route: route or route(.subRoute).

push_types.description: Exact push notification type case names, one per item.

settings_flags.description: Remote/local settings fields or feature flags that gate or tune the feature.

depends_on.description: Other feature ids, any area. Exact ids only; unknown ids are reported by the merge and resolved by reconciliation.

legacy_naming.description: Inconsistent or historical names: types, JSON keys, file names.

known_issues.description: TODO/FIXME, fragile code, dead code, half-finished parts. As observed, no fixes proposed.

source_files.description: Every file implementing the feature, relative to the source root, one path per item.

verified_addition.description: Set by apply_verification.py: the verification scope that added this feature.

merged_from.description: Set by reconcile_inventory.py: ids of duplicate features merged into this one.

migration_notes.description: Decisions recorded against this feature (see DECISIONS.md).

reason.description: dead code / shared utility / unclear / belongs to another area.

open_questions.description: Things that could not be determined from code. Guesses go here, not into features.
